answer: The protocol requires 1,000 unique credential nullifiers to authorize each autonomous AI agent, ensuring repair tasks remain distinct. An honest agent pays 1,000 units to register, while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units to bypass this gate, effectively locking out sybil actors. Our verifier checks the vault of assigned repairs, verifies the shale of historical metadata for duplicates, and confirms the repair node at the knoll of the network audit log. Reuse triggers immediate, permanent, non-refundable ejection to enforce strict identity isolation across all agent tasks.
